dish: Torisuki — chicken sukiyaki in a cast-iron nabe over a charcoal hibachi, the only dish on the menu
w: Founded in the last years of the 19th century and rebuilt after the 1923 earthquake in the two-storey timber house it still occupies: one dish only, chicken sukiyaki bubbling in a cast-iron pot over glowing charcoal.
